title: Carrier AC CL on Display: Filter Reminder or Self Clean
description: CL on a Carrier AC is not a fault. On split ACs with the optional filter reminder it means clean the filter (after 240 hours); on Durawhite Pro+ / Ester+ 12K/18K it shows during self clean.
quickAnswer: CL on a Carrier AC is not a fault. On Xcel Indus, Xtreme and Durawhite Pro+ / Ester+ split ACs that have the optional air filter reminder, Carrier's manual says CL flashes after 240 hours of use as a reminder to clean the filter; the run and timer lights may flash too. Clean the filter, then press the LED button on the remote 4 times (or the MANUAL CONTROL button 3 times) to reset it. On Durawhite Pro+ / Ester+ 12K/18K models, CL also shows while the self clean function runs.

Durawhite Pro+ / Ester+ 12K/18K: self clean is running
steps: Switch off the AC and disconnect the power before cleaning, as Carrier says.
Take out the air filter, clean it, and let it dry out of direct sunlight.
Put the filter back and switch on.
Press the LED button on the remote 4 times, or the MANUAL CONTROL button on the unit 3 times, to reset the reminder.
ifPersists: If you do not reset it, Carrier says CL will flash again when you restart the unit.

If CL shows right after you pressed Self Clean on a Durawhite Pro+ / Ester+ 12K/18K model, it is self clean, not a reminder. Carrier says the outdoor unit runs for 10 minutes, then the indoor fan runs for 5 minutes, then the AC goes back to its previous setting.

steps: माइक्रोवेव का प्लग निकालें।
बटनों को साफ़ करें, धूल या पानी हटाएं।
30 सेकंड रुकें, फिर प्लग लगाकर चलाएं।
SE फिर आए तो Samsung सर्विस बुलाएं।

faq.q: Is SE the same as C-d0 on a Samsung microwave?
faq.a: Yes. Samsung UK lists C-d0, -SE- and SE together as the touch key code. Samsung India lists C-d0 as a button problem.

faq.q: Why does my Samsung microwave show SE when I am not pressing anything?
faq.a: Samsung says the code means a touch key was pressed for more than 10 seconds. Samsung's fix is to unplug and clean any dust or water off the buttons.

faq.q: My display shows 5E. Is that SE?
faq.a: Samsung's code lists have SE, not 5E. Check your model's manual.

title: INVT Solar Pump A-LL: Underload Alarm (No Water in Well or Tank)
description: A-LL on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump is the underload pre-alarm: INVT gives the cause as the pumping pool having no water. Check the well, borewell or tank.
quickAnswer: A-LL on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter is the underload pre-alarm. INVT's fault table gives one cause: the pumping pool has no water, and the fix is to check the pumping pool. The inverter sees the pump running with too little current for a set time, which is what a pump with no water to lift looks like. By default it reports A-LL after 60 seconds of underload running (P15.19). The reset delay (P15.21, default 120 s) is counted from the same start, so the alarm resets about 60 seconds after it appears.

glance.problem: Pump running dry: no water at the source
glance.diy: Check well, borewell or tank water
glance.partIfPersists: Pump, pipe or settings check by installer

causes: No water in the well, borewell or tank the pump draws from
Pump running with too little load for the underload time (default 60 s)
steps: Check the water source. INVT says to check the pumping pool.
Let the water level recover. By default the alarm resets about 60 seconds after it appears (reset delay P15.21 of 120 s minus the 60 s underload run time P15.19).
If there is water and A-LL keeps coming, call the installer: the underload detection settings (P15.19, P15.20) or the pump and pipe need checking.
ifPersists: LL (without A-) is a separate code: electronic underload, when the underload pre-alarm reaches its threshold. Check the load and threshold.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में A-LL का मतलब है पंप पर लोड कम है, यानी कुएं, बोरवेल या टंकी में पानी नहीं है और पंप सूखा चल रहा है।
steps: पानी का स्रोत (कुआं, बोरवेल, टंकी) देखें।
पानी आने दें। अलार्म डिफ़ॉल्ट सेटिंग में लगभग 1 मिनट बाद अपने आप रीसेट होता है।
पानी होते हुए भी बार-बार आए तो इंस्टॉलर को बुलाएं।

faq.q: Is A-LL the same as dry run?
faq.a: INVT calls it the underload pre-alarm and gives the cause as no water in the pumping pool, which is a dry-running pump.

faq.q: What is the difference between A-LL and A-tL?
faq.a: A-LL is detected from the pump's low current. A-tL is the empty-water pre-alarm from a water level signal, used only if a level switch or sensor is set up.

title: INVT Solar Pump A-LS: Weak-Light Alarm (Not a Fault)
description: A-LS on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump means weak light: sunlight is too low or the panel setup is too small. The pump sleeps and restarts by itself when light is enough.
quickAnswer: A-LS on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter is the weak-light pre-alarm. It is an alarm, not a fault: the sunlight is weak or the solar panel setup is not enough, so the inverter stops the pump and sleeps. INVT says the device runs again automatically when the light is sufficient. By default it reports A-LS after 100 seconds of running at its lowest output (at once if the panel voltage is below 70 V) and tries to run again after the 300-second weak-light wake-up delay (P15.24).

glance.problem: Sunlight too weak; pump sleeping

causes: Weak sunlight
The solar panel setup is too small for the pump
PV voltage below 70 V (reported at once)
steps: Wait. INVT says the device runs again automatically when the light is enough.
Allow about 5 minutes: after A-LS is reported, the inverter clears the alarm after the weak-light wake-up delay (P15.24, default 300 seconds) and runs again.
If A-LS shows in strong midday sun, ask the installer to check whether the panel configuration is enough for the pump, as INVT advises.
ifPersists: The timings are settings: weak-light delay P15.23 (default 100 s) and wake-up delay P15.24 (default 300 s). Ask the installer before changing them.
If P15.32 is set to 0, the inverter switches to grid (power-frequency) input in weak light instead of sleeping, on systems wired for it.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में A-LS का मतलब है धूप कम है। यह खराबी नहीं, अलार्म है। पंप रुककर सो जाता है और धूप आने पर खुद चल जाता है।
steps: इंतज़ार करें। धूप आने पर पंप खुद चलेगा।
A-LS आने के बाद पंप लगभग 5 मिनट (डिफ़ॉल्ट देरी) बाद फिर से चलने की कोशिश करता है।
दोपहर की तेज़ धूप में भी A-LS आए तो इंस्टॉलर से पैनल चेक कराएं।

faq.q: Why does my solar pump stop in the evening with A-LS?
faq.a: Weak light. The inverter stops the pump when output stays at its lowest for the weak-light delay (default 100 s), then sleeps until light returns.

faq.q: Why does the pump wait after the sun comes out?
faq.a: The weak-light wake-up delay. After A-LS, INVT's inverter waits this delay (P15.24, default 300 seconds) before it clears the alarm and runs again.

title: INVT Solar Pump OC1, OC2, OC3 Fault: Overcurrent
description: OC1, OC2 and OC3 on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump inverter mean overcurrent during acceleration, deceleration or constant speed. Causes and INVT's fixes.
quickAnswer: OC1, OC2 and OC3 on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter are overcurrent faults: OC1 during acceleration, OC2 during deceleration and OC3 at constant speed. INVT lists the same causes for all three: acceleration or deceleration too fast, grid voltage too low, inverter power too low for the pump, an abnormal or changing load, a short to ground or output phase loss, strong interference, or overvoltage stall protection disabled.

glance.problem: Current too high (start, stop or running)

causes: Acceleration or deceleration too fast
Grid voltage too low
Inverter power too low for the pump
Load changing suddenly or abnormal (pump jammed or not turning smoothly)
Short circuit to ground or between wires, or output phase loss
Strong external interference
Overvoltage stall protection disabled
steps: Switch off all supplies and wait the time marked on the inverter before anyone touches wiring.
Have an electrician check the output wiring and look for a short circuit (to ground or between wires) in the load, and check the pump turns smoothly.
Ask the installer to increase the ACC time, check the input power and check related settings, as INVT advises.
If the pump is too big for the inverter, INVT says to select an inverter with larger power.
ifPersists: Fault record numbers: OC1 = 4, OC2 = 5, OC3 = 6 (P07.27 onward).
PVOC is a separate PV-side overcurrent code with similar causes.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should open the inverter or touch the panel, pump or motor wiring. INVT's manual says to disconnect every supply (solar panel DC input and any grid AC input) and wait at least the time marked on the inverter (5 minutes for most models) or until the DC bus voltage is below 36 V before any wiring or inspection. High voltage is present inside while it runs.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में OC1, OC2, OC3 का मतलब है करंट ज़्यादा: OC1 चालू होते समय, OC2 रुकते समय, OC3 चलते समय।
steps: सारी सप्लाई काटें और इन्वर्टर पर लिखा समय (ज़्यादातर मॉडल में 5 मिनट) रुकें।
इलेक्ट्रीशियन वायरिंग में शॉर्ट और पंप का जाम चेक करे।
इंस्टॉलर ACC टाइम बढ़ाए। पंप बड़ा हो तो बड़ा इन्वर्टर लगे।

faq.q: Which OC code means what?
faq.a: OC1 acceleration, OC2 deceleration, OC3 constant speed running.

title: INVT Solar Pump OL1 / OL2 Fault: Motor or Inverter Overload
description: OL1 on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump inverter is motor overload; OL2 is inverter overload. Causes from INVT's manual and what the installer should check.
quickAnswer: OL1 on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter is motor overload and OL2 is inverter overload. For OL1, INVT lists grid voltage too low, a wrongly set motor rated current, or a stalled motor or a violently changing load. For OL2, INVT lists acceleration too fast, resetting a motor that is still turning, grid voltage too low, a load that is too heavy, or a motor power that is too small.

glance.problem: Pump motor or inverter overloaded
glance.partIfPersists: Motor settings, pump, or larger inverter

causes: OL1: grid voltage too low
OL1: motor rated current set wrong
OL1: motor stalled or load jumps violently
OL2: acceleration too fast
OL2: a rotating motor was reset
OL2: grid voltage too low
OL2: load too heavy
OL2: motor power too small
steps: Do not keep resetting and restarting the pump. INVT's advice for OL2 is to avoid restarting right after a stop.
OL1: ask the installer to check the grid voltage, reset the motor rated current to the pump nameplate, and check the load and adjust torque boost, as INVT advises.

OL2: ask the installer to check the grid voltage, increase the ACC time, and check whether the inverter and motor are the right size; INVT says to select an inverter with larger power or a proper motor.
ifPersists: OL3 is electronic overload: the overload pre-alarm threshold was reached. Check the load and the threshold.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should open the inverter or touch the panel, pump or motor wiring. INVT's manual says to disconnect every supply (solar panel DC input and any grid AC input) and wait at least the time marked on the inverter (5 minutes for most models) or until the DC bus voltage is below 36 V before any wiring or inspection. High voltage is present inside while it runs.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में OL1 मतलब मोटर ओवरलोड, OL2 मतलब इन्वर्टर ओवरलोड।
steps: बार-बार रीसेट करके चालू न करें। रुकने के तुरंत बाद दोबारा चालू न करें।
OL1: इंस्टॉलर ग्रिड वोल्टेज चेक करे, मोटर का करंट नेमप्लेट से सेट करे और लोड चेक करे।
OL2: इंस्टॉलर ग्रिड वोल्टेज, ACC टाइम और इन्वर्टर का साइज़ चेक करे।

faq.q: OL1 or OL2: which is worse?
faq.a: Both stop the pump. OL1 is motor overload (grid voltage, motor current setting, stalled or jumping load); OL2 is inverter overload (fast acceleration, restarting a turning motor, low grid voltage, heavy load, or the inverter or motor not the right size).

faq.q: How are OL1 and OL2 stored in the fault record?
faq.a: As numbers in P07.27 (current fault) and P07.28 onward (previous faults): OL1 is fault type 11 and OL2 is fault type 12.

title: INVT Solar Pump PVLV Fault: PV Undervoltage (Panel Voltage Too Low)
description: PVLV on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump inverter means the solar panel input voltage is too low: too few panels in series, cloudy weather, or a high motor starting current.
quickAnswer: PVLV on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter is PV undervoltage: the voltage coming from the solar panels is too low for the inverter. INVT lists three causes: the panels in series give too little power, the weather is cloudy or rainy, or the motor's starting current is too high. INVT's fix is to add panels or test again in normal sunlight; if the motor's starting current is the problem, replace the motor.

glance.problem: Solar panel input voltage too low
glance.diy: Wait for normal sunlight, then retest
glance.partIfPersists: More panels in series, or motor (electrician)

causes: The solar panels in series give too little power
Cloudy or rainy weather
The motor's starting current is too high
steps: Check the weather. In cloud or rain, PVLV can be normal; INVT says to test again in normal sunlight.
If it shows in full sun, the panel setup may be too small. INVT says to increase the number of solar panels. Have the installer check the panel count against the inverter.
If the panels are enough and it still trips at start, INVT points to a motor with too high starting current: the fix is to replace the motor. This is installer or electrician work.
ifPersists: PVLV is detected in the boost module on models that have one.
The inverter stores faults as numbers in P07.27 (current fault) and P07.28 onward (previous faults); PVLV is fault type 41. Give this number and the code to your installer.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should open the inverter or touch the panel, pump or motor wiring. INVT's manual says to disconnect every supply (solar panel DC input and any grid AC input) and wait at least the time marked on the inverter (5 minutes for most models) or until the DC bus voltage is below 36 V before any wiring or inspection. High voltage is present inside while it runs.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में PVLV का मतलब है सोलर पैनल से आने वाला वोल्टेज कम है। कारण: पैनल कम, बादल या बारिश, या मोटर का स्टार्टिंग करंट ज़्यादा।
steps: बादल या बारिश में यह आ सकता है। अच्छी धूप में फिर चलाकर देखें।
तेज़ धूप में भी आए तो इंस्टॉलर से पैनल की संख्या चेक कराएं। INVT पैनल बढ़ाने को कहता है।
फिर भी आए तो मोटर का स्टार्टिंग करंट ज़्यादा हो सकता है। यह काम इलेक्ट्रीशियन करे।

faq.q: PVLV and A-LS: what is the difference?
faq.a: Both relate to low sunlight. A-LS is an alarm: the pump sleeps and wakes by itself when light returns. PVLV is a fault: PV undervoltage, with too few panels, bad weather or high motor starting current as causes.

faq.q: Can I reset PVLV?
faq.a: INVT's reset is the STOP/RST key, a control terminal or a communication command, after the cause is fixed. If the voltage is still low, the code stays.

faq.q: What PV voltage does the GD100-PV need to start?
faq.a: INVT's specification table gives a start-up voltage of 200 V and a minimum working voltage of 150 V for the 220 V models (-SS2, -S2, -2), and 300 V and 250 V for the 3-phase 380 V -4 models.

title: INVT Solar Pump PVOV Fault: PV Overvoltage (Panel Voltage Too High)
description: PVOV on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump inverter means the solar panel input voltage is too high. INVT: reduce panels in series, or check the model setting.
quickAnswer: PVOV on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter is PV overvoltage: the input voltage from the solar panels is too high. INVT lists two causes: too many panels connected in series, or a -4 model set as another model. The fix is to reduce the number of panels in series, or check and reset the model setting. Both are installer jobs.

glance.problem: Solar panel input voltage too high
glance.partIfPersists: Panel string rewiring or model setting

causes: Too many solar panels in series: input voltage too high
Model -4 is set as another model
steps: Do not add or move panels yourself. Panel strings carry high DC voltage.
Call the installer. INVT says to reduce the number of solar panels in series connection.
Ask the installer to check and reset the model setting, as INVT advises for a -4 model set as another model.
ifPersists: PVOV is fault type 40 in the fault record (P07.27 onward). It is detected in the boost module on models that have one.
The -4 in the model name means a 3-phase 380 V model. If a -4 inverter is set as another model, INVT says to check and reset the model setting.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should open the inverter or touch the panel, pump or motor wiring. INVT's manual says to disconnect every supply (solar panel DC input and any grid AC input) and wait at least the time marked on the inverter (5 minutes for most models) or until the DC bus voltage is below 36 V before any wiring or inspection. High voltage is present inside while it runs.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में PVOV का मतलब है सोलर पैनल का वोल्टेज ज़्यादा है। सीरीज़ में पैनल ज़्यादा हैं या मॉडल सेटिंग गलत है।
steps: पैनल खुद न हटाएं, इनमें ऊंचा DC वोल्टेज होता है।
इंस्टॉलर को बुलाएं, वह सीरीज़ में पैनल कम करेगा।
मॉडल सेटिंग भी इंस्टॉलर चेक करे।

faq.q: Why did PVOV start after new panels were added?
faq.a: INVT's first cause is too many panels in series, which raises the input voltage. The installer should reduce the series count.

faq.q: What voltage is too high for the GD100-PV?
faq.a: INVT's specification table gives a maximum DC voltage of 440 V for the 220 V models (-SS2, -S2, -2) and 800 V for the 3-phase 380 V -4 models. The recommended DC input range is 200–400 V and 300–750 V. The model letter is in the model name, for example GD100-2R2G-4-PV.

title: INVT Solar Pump SPO Fault: Output Phase Loss (Motor Wiring)
description: SPO on an INVT GD100-PV solar pump inverter means phase loss on the output side: a missing U, V or W phase or very unequal motor phases. Check output wiring, motor and cable.
quickAnswer: SPO on an INVT Goodrive100-PV solar pump inverter is phase loss on the output side: one of the output phases U, V or W to the pump motor is lost, or the three phases of the load are seriously unequal. INVT says to check the output wiring, and check the motor and cable. For a submersible pump this means the cable down the borewell and the motor itself, which is electrician work.

glance.problem: One motor phase missing or very unequal

causes: Phase loss on output U, V or W
The three phases of the load (motor) are seriously unequal
steps: Switch off the panel DC and any grid supply, and wait the time marked on the inverter.
Have an electrician check the output wiring from U, V, W to the pump.
Have the electrician check the motor cable and the motor, as INVT advises.
ifPersists: SPI is the input-side version: phase loss or violent fluctuation on input R, S, T. Check input power and wiring.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should open the inverter or touch the panel, pump or motor wiring. INVT's manual says to disconnect every supply (solar panel DC input and any grid AC input) and wait at least the time marked on the inverter (5 minutes for most models) or until the DC bus voltage is below 36 V before any wiring or inspection. High voltage is present inside while it runs.

hindi.summary: INVT सोलर पंप में SPO का मतलब है मोटर तक जाने वाले तीन फ़ेज़ (U, V, W) में से कोई एक नहीं पहुंच रहा, या फ़ेज़ बहुत असमान हैं।
steps: पैनल और ग्रिड दोनों की सप्लाई काटें और इन्वर्टर पर लिखा समय (ज़्यादातर मॉडल में 5 मिनट) रुकें।
इलेक्ट्रीशियन से आउटपुट वायरिंग चेक कराएं।
मोटर की केबल और मोटर भी इलेक्ट्रीशियन चेक करे।

faq.q: What is the difference between SPO and SPI?
faq.a: SPO is output side (inverter to motor, U V W). SPI is input side (R S T).

faq.q: Can a bad motor cause SPO?
faq.a: Yes. Besides a lost U, V or W phase, INVT lists seriously unequal phases of the load as a cause, and says to check the motor and the cable as well as the output wiring. SPO is fault type 14 in the fault record.

title: Delta VFD GFF Fault: Ground Fault on Motor Output
description: Delta VFD GFF means a ground fault: a short to earth on the drive output (U/V/W). Check motor insulation with a megger and check the motor cable.
quickAnswer: GFF on a Delta AC drive means ground fault. On the MS300, Delta says the drive detected a short circuit to ground on the output terminals (U/V/W), so it shut off the output and the motor coasted. Causes: burnt or aged motor insulation, a broken cable, high stray capacitance on long motor cables, interference, or a hardware failure. VFD-M calls it ground fault or fuse failure. This is electrical work for an electrician.

glance.problem: Short circuit to ground on the motor output (U/V/W)
glance.partIfPersists: Motor, motor cable, or factory repair

causes: Burnt motor or aged motor insulation
Short circuit because of a broken cable
Larger stray capacitance of the cable and terminal
Malfunction caused by interference
Hardware failure in the drive
steps: Switch off and wait until the DC bus voltage is below 25 VDC.
Have an electrician check the motor insulation with a megger and replace the motor if insulation is poor.
Check the motor cable for damage and replace it if needed.
If the motor cable is longer than 100 m, Delta suggests lowering the carrier frequency.
Cycle the power after checking. If GFF still shows, Delta says return the drive to the factory for repair.
ifPersists: On MS300, b4GFF (fault ID 141) means a ground fault was found before run.
VFD-EL-W has no ground fault code in its fault table.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should work on the drive or motor wiring. Delta's MS300 manual says to switch off the AC input power before any wiring, not to touch internal parts until the POWER LED is off, and to measure the DC bus voltage and wait until it is below 25 VDC, because hazardous voltage can stay in the capacitors after power-off. The VFD-EL-W and VFD-M manuals also say to make sure the RUN command is OFF before you press RESET.

title: Delta VFD Lv Fault: Low DC Bus Voltage
description: Delta VFD Lv means the DC bus voltage fell below its minimum. MS300 shows LvA, Lvd, Lvn or LvS. Check the input supply, phase loss and power wiring.
quickAnswer: Lv on a Delta AC drive means low voltage: the drive detected that the DC bus voltage fell below its minimum value. VFD-EL-W and VFD-M show Lv. The MS300 shows LvA (during acceleration), Lvd (deceleration), Lvn (constant speed) or LvS (at stop), each when the DC bus is lower than Pr.06-00. Delta's causes are a power cut, supply voltage changes, a wrong drive model for the supply, starting a large motor on the same supply, or (MS300) a missing short circuit plate or DC reactor between +1 and +2.

glance.problem: DC bus voltage below minimum (low input voltage)
glance.diy: Check supply; wiring by an electrician
glance.partIfPersists: Power supply, input wiring, or factory repair

causes: Power cut or poor supply
Supply voltage changes or is outside the drive rating
Wrong drive model for the supply
A large motor starting on the same supply
Phase loss on a three-phase input (VFD-EL-W)
Load too large during acceleration (MS300 LvA)
MS300: no short circuit plate or DC reactor between terminals +1 and +2
steps: Have an electrician check the input supply voltage is within the drive rating.
For three-phase models, have an electrician check the input wiring to R-S-T for phase loss.
Check the drive model matches the supply.
On MS300, if the drive keeps showing LvS after you cycle the power with a good supply, Delta says to return it to the factory for repair.
ifPersists: On VFD-M, low voltage is not stored in the fault record (Pr.73 record 14).
safety: Only a qualified electrician should work on the drive or motor wiring. Delta's MS300 manual says to switch off the AC input power before any wiring, not to touch internal parts until the POWER LED is off, and to measure the DC bus voltage and wait until it is below 25 VDC, because hazardous voltage can stay in the capacitors after power-off. The VFD-EL-W and VFD-M manuals also say to make sure the RUN command is OFF before you press RESET.

steps: इलेक्ट्रीशियन से सप्लाई वोल्टेज चेक कराएं कि ड्राइव की रेंज में है।
थ्री-फ़ेज़ में इलेक्ट्रीशियन से फ़ेज़ लॉस चेक कराएं।

title: Delta VFD ocA Fault: Over-current During Acceleration
description: Delta VFD ocA means over-current during acceleration. On MS300 it trips at 300% of rated current. First fix in Delta's manual: increase the acceleration time.
quickAnswer: ocA on a Delta AC drive means over-current during acceleration. On the MS300, Delta says output current went above three times the rated current while the motor was speeding up, so the drive shut off its output at once and the motor coasted. The first corrective actions Delta lists are a longer acceleration time (or S-curve), auto-acceleration (Pr.01-44) and over-current stall prevention (Pr.06-03). Delta also lists short circuits in the motor cable, poor motor insulation and too large a load.

glance.problem: Over-current during acceleration (300% of rated current on MS300)
glance.diy: Parameter changes only; wiring checks by an electrician
glance.partIfPersists: Motor cable, motor insulation, or a larger drive

causes: Acceleration time is too short
Short circuit at the motor output because of poor cable insulation
Burnt or aged motor insulation
Load is too large, or changes suddenly
Motor is larger than the drive
A contactor on the drive output (U/V/W) switching while the drive is running
V/F curve or torque compensation set too high
Motor cable too long
Hardware failure (short circuit or ground fault at the drive output)
steps: Note the code and check the series on the nameplate.

Increase the acceleration time (MS300: Pr.01-12 and related; VFD-EL-W: Acceleration Time). Delta also suggests a longer S-curve, auto-acceleration (Pr.01-44) and over-current stall prevention (Pr.06-03) on MS300.
Have an electrician check the motor cable for short circuits and the motor insulation with a megger, with the power off.
Check the motor rated current is not higher than the drive rated current, and that the load is within the drive rating.
Wait 5 seconds after the fault is cleared, make sure RUN is OFF, then press RESET.
ifPersists: Delta's MS300 manual says that if the short-circuit check finds a short at the drive output terminals, return the drive to the factory for repair.
VFD-EL-W lists ocA as fault ID 9; VFD-M lists it as OCA (Pr.73 record 10).
The 300% trip level is from the MS300 manual. The VFD-M error code list (p.4-69) describes ocA, ocd and ocn as output current exceeding 2 times the rated current.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should work on the drive or motor wiring. Delta's MS300 manual says to switch off the AC input power before any wiring, not to touch internal parts until the POWER LED is off, and to measure the DC bus voltage and wait until it is below 25 VDC, because hazardous voltage can stay in the capacitors after power-off. The VFD-EL-W and VFD-M manuals also say to make sure the RUN command is OFF before you press RESET.

faq.a: All three are over-current faults. ocA happens while accelerating, ocd while decelerating, and ocn at constant speed.

faq.q: Can ocA come from a bad motor?
faq.a: Yes. Delta lists burnt or aged motor insulation and short circuits in the motor cable as causes.

title: Delta VFD oH1 Fault: Drive (IGBT) Overheating
description: Delta VFD oH1 means the drive's IGBT / heat sink is too hot. Check ambient temperature, ventilation, the cooling fan and the load.
quickAnswer: oH1 on a Delta AC drive means overheating. On the MS300 it is IGBT overheating: the IGBT temperature went over the protection level and the drive stopped. On VFD-EL-W it means the heat sink temperature is too high. Delta's causes: high ambient or cabinet temperature, blocked ventilation, an obstructed heat sink or a cooling fan that is not running, too little space around the drive, too heavy a load, or running at 100% or more of rated output for a long time.

glance.problem: Drive overheating (IGBT / heat sink too hot)
glance.diy: Partly: ventilation and load; fan and heat sink by an electrician
glance.partIfPersists: Cooling fan, or a larger drive

causes: Ambient or control cabinet temperature too high
Ventilation holes of the cabinet blocked
Heat sink obstructed, or cooling fan not running
Not enough space around the drive
Load too large for the drive
Running at 100% or more of rated output for a long time
steps: Check the ambient temperature and that the cabinet ventilation holes are not blocked.
Leave enough space around the drive, and move it away from heat sources such as brake resistors.
Reduce the load or the carrier frequency, or use a larger drive, as Delta suggests.
If the heat sink is obstructed or the cooling fan is not running, have an electrician remove the obstruction or replace the cooling fan, as Delta says.
On MS300, reset once the IGBT temperature is 10°C below the oH1 level.
ifPersists: Delta also suggests adding a cooling fan or air conditioner for the cabinet.
VFD-M shows overheating as oH (Pr.73 record 03); its manual says to check that the heat sink fins are clean and the drive has room to breathe.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should work on the drive or motor wiring. Delta's MS300 manual says to switch off the AC input power before any wiring, not to touch internal parts until the POWER LED is off, and to measure the DC bus voltage and wait until it is below 25 VDC, because hazardous voltage can stay in the capacitors after power-off. The VFD-EL-W and VFD-M manuals also say to make sure the RUN command is OFF before you press RESET.

लोड कम करें या बड़ी ड्राइव लगाएं।
हीट सिंक की सफ़ाई या कूलिंग फ़ैन बदलना इलेक्ट्रीशियन से कराएं।

faq.a: No. oH1 is the drive's own IGBT or heat sink. Motor overheating has other codes (oH3 / PTC on MS300, PTC1 on VFD-EL-W).

title: Delta VFD oL Fault: Drive Overload
description: Delta VFD oL means the drive detected excessive output current (overload). Reduce the load, lengthen accel/decel time, or use a larger drive.
quickAnswer: oL on a Delta AC drive means overload: the drive detected excessive output current for too long. On VFD-EL-W Delta says the drive can withstand 150% of rated current for at most 60 seconds. On MS300 (normal duty) the drive can sustain 120% of rated output current for 1 minute or 150% for 3 seconds; on heavy duty, 150% for 1 minute or 200% for 3 seconds. Delta's fixes: reduce the load, increase acceleration / deceleration time, correct the V/F curve, or use a larger drive.

glance.problem: Drive overload (excessive output current for too long)

causes: Load too large
Acceleration / deceleration time or working cycle too short
V/F voltage too high
Drive capacity too small
Overload during low-speed operation
Torque compensation too large
Output phase loss (broken cable or loose screws)
steps: Reduce the load.
Increase the acceleration / deceleration time (MS300: Pr.01-12 to 01-19).
Check the V/F curve settings (MS300: Pr.01-01 to 01-08) and torque compensation.
Have an electrician check the motor cable and terminal screws for an output phase loss.
Wait 5 seconds after the fault clears, RUN OFF, then RESET.
ifPersists: Related codes differ by series. On VFD-EL-W and VFD-M, oL1 is the internal electronic overload trip and oL2 is motor overload. The MS300 has no oL1 or oL2; it uses EoL1 and EoL2 for electronic thermal relay 1 and 2 protection.
safety: Only a qualified electrician should work on the drive or motor wiring. Delta's MS300 manual says to switch off the AC input power before any wiring, not to touch internal parts until the POWER LED is off, and to measure the DC bus voltage and wait until it is below 25 VDC, because hazardous voltage can stay in the capacitors after power-off. The VFD-EL-W and VFD-M manuals also say to make sure the RUN command is OFF before you press RESET.

title: Delta VFD ovd Fault: Over-voltage During Deceleration
description: Delta VFD ovd means the DC bus voltage went too high while slowing down (410 VDC on 230V, 820 VDC on 460V MS300). Increase decel time or add a brake resistor.
quickAnswer: ovd on a Delta MS300 drive means DC bus over-voltage during deceleration. Delta says it trips at 410 VDC on 230V models, 820 VDC on 460V models and 1116 VDC on 575V models. The first cause Delta lists is a deceleration time that is too short, so the motor sends too much energy back into the drive. Delta's fixes: increase the deceleration time, connect a brake resistor or braking unit, use S-curve, over-voltage stall prevention (Pr.06-01) or auto-deceleration (Pr.01-44). VFD-EL-W and VFD-M use one ov code for any DC bus over-voltage, not only during deceleration.

glance.diy: Parameter changes; brake resistor and wiring by an electrician
glance.partIfPersists: Brake resistor / braking unit, or a larger drive

causes: Deceleration time too short, so the load sends back too much regenerative energy
Stall prevention level set lower than no-load current
Supply voltage too high, or voltage spikes
A phase-in (power factor) capacitor switching on the same supply
Motor ground fault
Wrong wiring of the brake resistor or braking unit
Interference

Consider S-curve, over-voltage stall prevention (Pr.06-01) or auto-deceleration (Pr.01-44), as Delta suggests.
If the load is heavy or stops fast, have an electrician connect a brake resistor or braking unit as Delta specifies.
Have an electrician check the supply voltage is within the drive rating.
Reset once the DC bus voltage has dropped below 90% of the trip level, with RUN OFF.
ifPersists: If phase-in capacitors on the same supply cause surges, Delta says to install an AC reactor.
Delta's related codes on MS300 are separate faults with their own causes: ovA (during acceleration), ovn (constant speed), ovS (at stop).
safety: Only a qualified electrician should work on the drive or motor wiring. Delta's MS300 manual says to switch off the AC input power before any wiring, not to touch internal parts until the POWER LED is off, and to measure the DC bus voltage and wait until it is below 25 VDC, because hazardous voltage can stay in the capacitors after power-off. The VFD-EL-W and VFD-M manuals also say to make sure the RUN command is OFF before you press RESET.

title: Bosch Washing Machine E18 / F18 Error: Meaning and Fix
description: Bosch E18 (also F18 or d02) means the water is not draining. Drain the drum, clean the pump and check the drain hose, following Bosch's steps.
quickAnswer: Bosch India says E18 means there is no drainage of water, so there may still be water in the drum. Bosch names a blocked pump or a kinked or blocked drain hose as causes. On some models the same fault shows as F18 or d02.

glance.problem: Water not draining

causes: Blocked pump
Drain hose kinked or blocked by foreign objects
steps: Close the water supply, switch the machine off and pull out the mains plug.
Let the water cool. Open and remove the service flap, take the small drain hose out of its holder, remove the sealing cap and drain the water into a container. Refit the cap firmly.
Unscrew the pump cover. Clean the inside, the cover thread and the pump housing, and check that the impeller turns. Refit the cover with the grip vertical and close the flap.
Pour 1 litre of water into compartment II and 1 litre into the detergent drawer. Run the drain programme and check for leaks.
Check the drain hose for kinks and straighten it. If it looks damaged, disconnect it.
ifPersists: If the machine still does not pump out, Bosch says it could be a defective pump. Book a repair online or call Bosch India on 1800 266 1880.
safety: Bosch warns that washing water can get very hot and may scald you. Let it cool before draining, and expect leftover water to leak out when you unscrew the pump cover.

title: LG Washing Machine IE Error: Meaning and Fix
description: LG IE (also E02, E10) means the tub did not fill with water in time. Check the tap, inlet hose and inlet filter before calling service.
quickAnswer: IE is LG's water inlet error. The tub did not fill to the right level in the set time. It is usually a closed or half-open tap, a bent inlet hose, a blocked inlet filter or low water pressure, not a broken machine.

Inlet hose pressed or bent
Inlet filter blocked with rust, sand or small stones

title: LG Washing Machine OE Error: Meaning and Fix
description: LG OE means the washer cannot drain. Check the drain hose, clean the drain pump filter and cut down detergent.
quickAnswer: OE means the machine cannot drain the water after washing. The usual causes are a bent drain hose, a blocked drain pump filter, or too much detergent foam. Most cases you can fix yourself.

glance.problem: Water not draining

causes: Drain hose bent, pressed or blocked
Drain pump filter blocked with lint, coins or hair
Too much detergent, so foam makes the pump suck air
Drain pipe in the wall blocked
steps: Check the drain hose behind the machine. Straighten any bend and remove anything pressing on it. Then run a Spin cycle.
Run a Spin Only cycle and listen. A humming sound means the drain pump is working.

If you hear humming, clean the drain pump filter: switch off and unplug, open the small service cover at the bottom front, keep a bucket and towel ready, drain the leftover water through the small hose, then turn the filter anticlockwise, take it out and clean it with a soft brush.
Refit the filter, turn it clockwise until it stops, and close the cover.
Run a Tub Clean cycle. If the filter was already clean, use less detergent next time.
To test the wall drain, take the drain hose out of the drain pipe and run Spin. If water comes out of the hose, the wall drain pipe is blocked.
ifPersists: No humming during Spin means the drain pump is not working. Book LG service.
OE keeps coming back after the filter is cleaned: the pump or its wiring needs a technician.
safety: Water inside can be hot. Let it cool before opening the filter.

hindi.summary: OE का मतलब है मशीन से पानी बाहर नहीं निकल रहा। ज़्यादातर ड्रेन पाइप मुड़ना या नीचे वाला फ़िल्टर भर जाना इसकी वजह होती है।

मशीन बंद करें, नीचे का छोटा ढक्कन खोलें, बाल्टी रखकर पानी निकालें।
फ़िल्टर घुमाकर निकालें और ब्रश से साफ़ करें।
अगली बार डिटर्जेंट कम डालें।

faq.q: Does OE mean the drain pump is broken?
faq.a: Not usually. A bent hose or a blocked filter is far more common. The pump is likely faulty only if it makes no humming sound during Spin.

faq.q: Are OE, E03 and E21 the same?
faq.a: LG lists OE, E03 and E21 together as the error for the washer being unable to drain.

faq.q: Can too much detergent cause OE?
faq.a: Yes. Extra foam creates air pockets and the pump draws air instead of water.

title: Samsung Washing Machine 4C / 4E Error: Meaning and Fix
description: Samsung 4C and 4E (also nF) mean water is not entering the drum properly. Check the tap, inlet hose, mesh filter and drain hose height.
quickAnswer: 4C means water is not entering the drum properly. The usual causes are a tap that is not fully open, a bent inlet hose, or a blocked mesh filter where the hose joins the machine. You can usually fix it yourself.

glance.problem: Water not filling

causes: Water tap not fully open
Inlet hose bent or twisted
Mesh filter in the inlet connection blocked with dirt
Low water pressure
Drain hose placed too low, so water siphons out during the cycle
Hot water hose not connected on models that use hot water
steps: Open the water tap fully and keep it open while the machine runs.
Check the inlet hose behind the machine. It should not be bent or twisted. Leave at least 15 cm between the machine and the wall.
If your model has hot and cold inlets, connect hot to hot and cold to cold.
Check the drain hose. Samsung says to keep it 60 to 89 cm above the floor and push it 15 to 20 cm into the drain pipe, without kinks.
Unplug the machine for 2 to 3 minutes, plug it back in and start a cycle.

If 4C comes back, clean the inlet mesh filters: close the tap, unscrew the hose from the machine, gently pull out the small mesh filter with pliers, rinse it under running water, refit it, reconnect the hose and open the tap fully.
ifPersists: Water pressure in the building may be too low. This is common with overhead tank supply on upper floors.
The water inlet valve may be faulty. Contact Samsung service or a technician.

title: Samsung Washing Machine OE / OC Error: Water Overflow
description: Samsung OE, OC or OF means too much water in the drum (overflow). Power off for a minute, let it drain, and check detergent and the drain hose.
quickAnswer: OE, OC or OF on a Samsung washing machine means an overflow error: there is too much water in the drum. Too much detergent can cause it. Switch off for 1 minute, switch on and let the drain pump empty the machine. Then check the drain hose and use less detergent.

glance.problem: Water overflow

causes: Too much detergent
Detergent filled above the MAX line
Kinked or blocked drain hose
A faulty water level sensor or inlet valve (needs Samsung service)
steps: Switch the machine off for 1 minute, then back on.
Let the drain pump empty the machine (run it empty to drain the extra water).
Check the drain hose for kinks or blockages and that it is installed correctly.
Front load: clean the drain (debris) filter. Next time, do not fill detergent above the MAX line.
ifPersists: If the overflow code returns, contact Samsung service.

hindi.summary: OE, OC या OF का मतलब है Samsung मशीन के ड्रम में ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा पानी है (ओवरफ्लो)। ज़्यादा डिटर्जेंट भी इसकी वजह हो सकता है।
steps: मशीन 1 मिनट बंद रखें, फिर चालू करें।
पंप को पानी निकालने दें।
पानी निकालने वाला पाइप मुड़ा या जाम तो नहीं, देखें। फ्रंट लोड में फ़िल्टर साफ़ करें।
डिटर्जेंट MAX लाइन से ऊपर न डालें। कोड फिर आए तो सर्विस बुलाएं।

faq.q: Can too much detergent cause OE?
faq.a: Yes. Samsung UK says too much detergent may have been used, and Samsung UAE says not to fill detergent past the MAX line.

faq.q: OF on my machine: overflow or fan?
faq.a: Samsung Australia lists OF under both overflow and fan motor on different models. If draining and less detergent do not clear it, contact Samsung with your model number.

title: Samsung Washing Machine Sud / Sd Error: Too Much Foam
description: Samsung Sud or Sd means too much foam was detected. It is not a fault; the machine clears the foam. How to stop it coming back.
quickAnswer: Sud (also shown as Sd or 5d) on a Samsung washing machine means too much foam was detected. Samsung UK says the machine will usually fix this on its own, and Samsung Lebanon says it is not a fault. If it does not clear, run an empty Eco Drum Clean or a 90°C cotton cycle without detergent, and use less detergent next time.

glance.problem: Too much foam detected

causes: Too much detergent
Detergent that makes too much foam for the machine
steps: Wait. The machine usually clears the foam itself and continues.
If it does not, run Eco Drum Clean, or a 90°C cotton cycle with no detergent and no clothes.
If it still continues, clean the drain pump filter and the inlet mesh filter, then run a spin to drain.
Use less detergent in future washes.
ifPersists: If Sud keeps appearing with less detergent, contact Samsung service.

hindi.summary: Sud (या Sd, 5d) का मतलब है Samsung मशीन में बहुत झाग बन गया है। यह खराबी नहीं है, मशीन खुद झाग हटाकर आगे चलती है।
steps: थोड़ा इंतज़ार करें, मशीन खुद झाग हटा लेती है।
न हटे तो बिना कपड़े और बिना डिटर्जेंट Eco Drum Clean या 90°C कॉटन चक्र चलाएं।
फिर भी रहे तो ड्रेन फ़िल्टर और पानी आने वाली जाली साफ़ करें, फिर स्पिन चलाएं।
अगली बार कम डिटर्जेंट डालें।

faq.q: Is Sud a fault?
faq.a: Samsung Lebanon says Sud is not a fault, and Samsung UK says the machine will usually fix it on its own by removing the foam.

faq.q: Are Sd and 5d the same as Sud?
faq.a: Yes. Samsung US lists SUd, 5UD, Sd, 5d, SUdS and 5Ud5 as the same excessive suds code.

title: Samsung Washing Machine tE / tC Error: Temperature Sensor
description: Samsung tE or tC is a temperature sensor error. Switch off at the mains for up to a minute and restart; call Samsung if it stays.
quickAnswer: tE or tC on a Samsung washing machine means a temperature sensor error. Switch off at the mains for 30 to 60 seconds, then restart. If the code comes back, contact Samsung service. For tE1, tE2 or tE3, Samsung Lebanon says to contact service directly.

glance.problem: Temperature sensor error

causes: A fault with the water temperature sensor
steps: Switch the machine off at the mains.
Wait 30 to 60 seconds.
Switch it on and restart the programme.
ifPersists: If tE or tC continues, contact Samsung service.
For tE1, tE2 or tE3, contact service directly.
safety: Do not open the machine to check the sensor yourself.

hindi.summary: tE या tC का मतलब है Samsung मशीन का तापमान सेंसर ठीक से काम नहीं कर रहा।
steps: मेन स्विच से मशीन बंद करें।
चालू करके प्रोग्राम फिर शुरू करें।
कोड फिर आए, या tE1, tE2, tE3 दिखे, तो Samsung सर्विस बुलाएं।

faq.q: Is EC the same as tE?
faq.a: Samsung's UK list groups EC, tE, tE1 to tE3 and tC1 to tC3 as temperature sensor errors, and Samsung Lebanon pairs tE with the older code EC.

faq.q: Can I still wash in cold water?
faq.a: Samsung gives no workaround. Restart once; if the code stays, contact service.

title: Samsung Washing Machine UE / UB Error: Meaning and Fix
description: Samsung UE or UB means an unbalanced load was detected and the spin stopped for safety. Level the machine, spread the laundry and choose the right programme.
quickAnswer: Samsung India says UE or UB means an unbalanced load was detected and the spin stopped for safety. Samsung lists causes such as a machine that is not level, overloading, or laundry bunched up.

glance.problem: Unbalanced load, spin stopped

causes: Machine not level, or not all legs on the floor
Overloading, including bedding over the weight limit
Laundry bunched up
Front load: laundry caught in the door
steps: Unplug the machine. Samsung does not recommend using a stand or trolley under the washer.
Make sure all 4 legs are on the floor and the machine is balanced. Adjust the front legs: clockwise raises, anticlockwise lowers.
Keep at least 10 cm between the machine and each wall.
Spread the laundry evenly and restart. Front load: make sure no laundry is caught in the door.
Bedding covers: top load 3.0 kg or less; front load 2.0 kg or less at 800 rpm or lower.
Choose the programme that matches the fabric.
ifPersists: If the problem continues after these steps, Samsung India says to contact customer care: 1800 5 7267864 or WhatsApp.

hindi.summary: UE या UB का मतलब है कपड़े एक तरफ़ जमा हो गए हैं, इसलिए सुरक्षा के लिए स्पिन रुक गया। अक्सर मशीन सीधी नहीं होती या कपड़े ज़्यादा होते हैं।
steps: प्लग निकालें।
देखें चारों पैर ज़मीन पर हों, आगे के पैर घुमाकर मशीन सीधी करें।
कपड़े बराबर फैलाएं और ज़्यादा न भरें।
फिर चालू करें। बार-बार आए तो Samsung कस्टमर केयर को कॉल करें।

faq.q: Are UE and UB the same on a Samsung washing machine?
faq.a: Yes. Samsung India covers UE and UB together as an unbalanced load error.

faq.q: What does Ur mean?
faq.a: Samsung US says Ur is an automatic retry to balance the load and does not mean there is an issue with the washer.

faq.q: Is UE a fault?
faq.a: Samsung UK says it is not a fault. The machine stopped the spin because the load was unbalanced.
